prompt_expansion_mode.description: How much effort to spend rewriting the prompt before generation. 'disabled' skips prompt expansion. 'balanced' returns in about a second. 'quality' spends up to ~30s on a richer prompt.
prompt_expansion_mode.title: Prompt Expansion Mode

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: Video length in seconds. The output can run up to about 0.7 s longer than requested.

image_url.description: Optional URL of the image to use as the first frame. The video opens exactly on this image while the references keep the subjects consistent; the output canvas follows this image.
image_url.title: Start Image URL

reference_audio_urls.description: URLs of reference audio clips (2-15 seconds each, combined duration at most 15 seconds), referenced in the prompt as Audio 1, Audio 2, and so on. Images, videos, and audio can be provided individually or together. Reference images, videos, and audio clips must add up to at most 12 files.
reference_audio_urls.title: Reference Audio URLs

middle_frame_time.description: Target time for the middle image, in seconds from the start. Rounded to the nearest frame at 24 fps; it must fall strictly between the first and last frames of the requested duration. Requires middle_image_url.
middle_frame_time.title: Time (seconds)

prompt.description: Text prompt for video generation. Refer to reference assets by their modality and order in the reference lists: Image 1, Image 2, Video 1, Audio 1, and so on.
prompt.title: Prompt

reference_image_urls.description: URLs of subject/style reference images, referenced in the prompt as Image 1, Image 2, and so on. Reference images, videos, and audio clips must add up to at most 12 files.
reference_image_urls.title: Reference Image URLs

seed.description: Random seed. A random seed is selected when omitted.
seed.title: Seed

reference_video_urls.description: URLs of motion/reference video clips (2-15 seconds each, combined duration at most 15 seconds), referenced in the prompt as Video 1, Video 2, and so on. Reference images, videos, and audio clips must add up to at most 12 files.
reference_video_urls.title: Reference Video URLs

end_image_url.description: Optional URL of the image to use as the last frame. The video ends exactly on this image.
end_image_url.title: End Image URL

middle_image_url.description: Optional image to guide the video at middle_frame_time. Requires start and end images and native 480P or 768P resolution.
middle_image_url.title: Middle Image

aspect_ratio.description: The aspect ratio of the generated video.
aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio

reference_conditions.description: Ordered reference list; cross-modality order is semantic and is preserved end-to-end. Do not combine with reference_*_urls.

type.description: Reference modality. Cross-modality list order is semantic.
type.title: Type

reference_conditions.title: Reference Conditions

enable_safety_checker.description: If set to true, the safety checker will be enabled.
enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker

sync_mode.description: Return the generated video as base64 instead of a CDN URL.
sync_mode.title: Sync Mode

resolution.description: The native generation resolution, or 1080P latent refinement from a native 768P source.
resolution.title: Resolution

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
url.title: Url

file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
file_size.title: File Size

content_type.description: The mime type of the file.
content_type.title: Content Type

file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.
file_name.title: File Name

timings.description: Timing breakdown in seconds. 'inference' is the DiT denoising time on the GPU backend. Null on routes that do not report backend timings.
timings.title: Timings

expanded_prompt.description: The prompt after expansion, as sent to the model. Null when prompt expansion was disabled, left the prompt unchanged, or was performed internally by MiniMax's hosted API.
expanded_prompt.title: Expanded Prompt

seed.description: Base seed for reproducing the generation.
seed.title: Seed

reference_tokens.description: Packed reference conditioner rows encoded for this request (images, videos, keyframes, and audio). The first 4096 rows are included in the clip price.
reference_tokens.title: Reference Tokens
